job_description: Our great client in Downtown Milwaukee has an immediate opening for a API Software Engineer. If you are interested please apply with resume to aboettcher@apexsystems.com. Collaborate with the API Enablement team to build and maintain enterprise-grade internal tooling, API governance automation, and developer experience platforms. Contributes to the design and delivery of cross-cutting technical solutions — including API quality enforcement engines, SDK generators, and the enterprise API catalog — that enable domain teams to build and publish high-quality APIs at speed. Supports contract-first API development practices and tooling built around OpenAPI Specification (OAS). Participates in refinement, solution definition, and decomposition of features into deliverable work items. Works across organizational boundaries with domain engineering teams, Enterprise Architecture, and API Management to deliver on the team's highest-priority initiatives. Finds opportunities for continuous improvement and owns initiatives that help the team get better. Engages collaboratively, respects diverse perspectives, and communicates effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences.QualificationsBachelor's Degree or equivalent experience8+ years of professional software development experience required5+ years of experience with API design, development, and governance including OpenAPI Specification (OAS) and REST best practicesExperience with Java and/or Node.js/TypeScriptProficient in practices such as contract-first API design, API quality automation, and internal platform/tooling developmentProven track record of architecting and delivering significant developer tooling or platform solutions (e.g., SDK generators, compliance engines, API catalogs)Capable of working autonomously and delivering with minimal direction in an enterprise environmentEffective communicator with product, engineering, architecture, and business partners, with proven ability to communicate to both technical and non-technical audiences in varying forms and levels of detailSkills for SourcingMust-Have Skills:API Development (REST / OpenAPI), Java or Node.js/TypeScript, Internal Developer Tooling / Platform Engineering, Contract-First API DesignNice-to-Have Skills:API Quality / Compliance Automation (e.g., Spectral), Client SDK Generation (e.g., OpenAPI Generator / Kiota), API Catalog / Developer Portal Experience, Enterprise Authorization Patterns (PBAC or similar)EEO Employer Apex Systems is an equal opportunity employer.
